title: Scalable Learning of Determinantal Point Processes with Kernel-Structured Interactions
abstract: arXiv:2610.12829v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Determinantal point processes (DPPs) on a finite set are probability models that exhibit repulsion where inter-item similarities are encoded by a positive definite kernel matrix. Scaling DPP learning to large datasets typically requires imposing structural constraints on the kernel matrix, such as a low-rank-plus-diagonal form. However, structural assumptions introduce a severe trade-off between expressive power and computational scalability. Our study addresses this challenge by (a) modeling the full-rank interactions via a nonlinear kernel function and latent features, (b) designing a surrogate function for the maximum likelihood estimator, and (c) adopting stochastic optimization using random features of the nonlinear kernel. Numerical experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that our method significantly improves this trade-off, achieving better generalization performance with remarkable parameter efficiency.

translated_title: 具有核结构交互的可扩展行列式点过程学习
translated_abstract: 有限集合上的行列式点过程（DPP）是一种展现排斥性的概率模型，其中项目间的相似性由一个正定核矩阵编码。将DPP学习扩展到大规模数据集通常需要对核矩阵施加结构约束，例如低秩加对角形式。然而，这种结构性假设在表达能力与计算可扩展性之间引入了严重的权衡。我们的研究通过以下方式应对这一挑战：（a）通过非线性核函数和潜在特征对全秩交互进行建模；（b）为最大似然估计器设计替代函数；（c）采用基于非线性核随机特征的随机优化方法。在真实世界数据集上的数值实验表明，我们的方法显著改善了这一权衡，以卓越的参数效率实现了更好的泛化性能。
tldr: 该论文提出一种利用非线性核随机特征进行随机优化的可扩展行列式点过程学习方法，通过全秩交互建模与替代函数设计，突破了结构约束的局限，显著改善了表达能力与计算可扩展性之间的权衡，并以极高的参数效率获得了更好的泛化性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a scalable DPP learning method that models full-rank interactions via nonlinear kernels and latent features, and adopts stochastic optimization with kernel random features, significantly improving the trade-off between expressive power and computational scalability while achieving better generalization with remarkable parameter efficiency.
